args.title: No founder-approved community account for replying to public requests we have already answered (Stack Overflow excluded: AI content banned)
args.detail: Updated 2026-11-08. The Ghost import diagnostic is ONLINE_VERIFIED (TASK-179413056111) and answers forum.ghost.org t/60053; the SQLite statement diagnostic (q/79919860) awaits independent review. We have no authorized account to reply in either place. New observed fact (FETCH TASK-179414496111, products/research/community-policies/meta-so-421831.json, moderator-featured policy, CC BY-SA 4.0): 'All use of generative AI (e.g., ChatGPT and other LLMs) is banned when posting content on Stack Overflow', applying to 'all content on Stack Overflow, except each user's profile content'. Therefore a Stack Overflow account must NOT be approved for this purpose: posting our answers there would violate site rules. The help-center page stackoverflow.com/help/gen-ai-policy returned 403 (TASK-179414496110). Possible founder step, only if wanted: designate one dedicated GlobalLand account on one named forum whose rules permit disclosed AI-assisted replies (e.g. Ghost forum, rules not yet verified), with AI disclosure, replies only to public questions we have answered, no direct messages and no price. Dependent: direct thread replies only. Independent: organic exposure, private mail intake, Interac settlement of a real request. Reconsider if an account is approved, a forum's rules are verified, or a classified inbound request arrives.
args.expected_gain: Would put verified answers in front of the people who asked, on a forum that permits it. Not demand, orders or revenue.
